first_desc: Same smiling figure changes from raised-leg pose to standing pose with hands on hips; head unchanged.
Teacher and chalkboard replaced by scene of 'FEE you BETTER pay' paper with cash and briefcase over a red armchair with reclined person, left half.
Cream paper prop headed in red 'DEBT' with scribble lines appears right of the carton (x0.67-0.78, y0.4-0.66).
Hard cut from old-rules document plus five-line sentence to stick-figure teacher at left with pointer and green chalkboard right reading 'Must wait!'.
On the blank white canvas a small cartoon character (dark hair, dark scarf-jacket, white X on grey tee, flat mouth) appears at far left (x0.15-0.27, full height) in a single frame.
Paper and text removed; the wordmark is enlarged to fill the width with a tan outlined blob shape arching behind it.
Red title text and the man at right are removed in one frame, and box plus black logo jump left by roughly a quarter of the frame; right half left empty.

Poster and big carton replaced by red handwritten heading 'The *kinda* bad' top-left and an open-topped carton 'Business 1' lower centre; a small rocket with a tiny passenger bobs out of the box and leaves over 13 frames.
Document scene replaced by a dark-haired glasses-wearing character at left and five 'STUDY' papers popping in one by one to form a pile at right.
Chalkboard scene replaced by a small black SPACEX wordmark at centre which grows to nearly full width over the next frames.
Footage card cut to white screen with only the large black circular badge at left of centre; footage still plays in f8064-8066, cut lands at f8067.
Figure scene replaced by Starlink badge top-left, then a green zig-zag rising arrow draws on from bottom-left to top-right and the caption 'to infinity and beyond!' appears beside the badge.
A cluster of green dollar-sign money bags pops in on the right of the large character: one bag, then two, then three, then seven overlapping bags (x0.48-0.9, y0.17-0.8) over 12 frames.
Channel page on the laptop scrolls up: banner exits the top, channel header moves up, and a second row of thumbnails starts to enter at the bottom.
The SHARE box slides rightward from beside the left figure to the centre-right, where it is replaced by a '401K' document; surrounding people stay put.
Footage: man gestures with both hands.
Continued in-clip video motion in the live-action clip, subtitle fixed; clip frame size unchanged.
Small text 'victory twerk' appears left of character at waist height; character wiggles between two poses across four frames.
Lower comparison bar begins: a red beverage-logo tile appears at left under the SpaceX bar and widens over 4 frames, with the axis below it.
Hard cut at 15403 from photo and figure to a full-bleed drawing of scattered grey paper stacks around a beige annotated 'Rules' sheet; slow drift follows.
Logo with '100' shrinks and slides left and a blue illustrated definition card slides in on the right, giving a two-element layout.
